question: The book 'The Accidental Prime Minister' by Sanjaya Baru is based on which of the following Indian Prime Minister's life?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manmohan Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The book titled **'The Accidental Prime Minister: The Making and Unmaking of Manmohan Singh'** is a **2014** memoir written by **Sanjaya Baru**.
 
• **Sanjaya Baru** served as the **media advisor** and **chief spokesperson** to the **Prime Minister** from **May 2004 to August 2008**.
 
• The book provides an insider's account of **Dr. Manmohan Singh's** tenure as the **13th Prime Minister of India**, specifically focusing on his first term during the **United Progressive Alliance (UPA-I)** government.
 
• It details the power dynamics within the **Prime Minister's Office (PMO)** and discusses the influence exerted by **Congress President Sonia Gandhi** over policy and administrative decisions.
 
• A significant portion of the book highlights **Dr. Singh’s** determination regarding the **Indo-US Civil Nuclear Agreement**, depicting it as a defining moment of his political career. ***Hence, the correct answer is Manmohan Singh.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dr. Manmohan Singh:**
 
 
• He served as the **Prime Minister of India** for two consecutive terms from **2004 to 2014**.
 
• An acclaimed economist, he held several key positions including **Governor of the Reserve Bank of India (1982–1985)** and **Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission (1985–1987)**.
 
• As the **Union Finance Minister** in **1991**, he was the chief architect of **economic liberalization** in India, introducing the **LPG (Liberalization, Privatization, and Globalization)** model.
 
 
 
• **Film Adaptation:**
 
 
• The book was adapted into a **biographical film** of the same name, released in **January 2019**.
 
• The film featured **Anupam Kher** in the lead role of **Dr. Manmohan Singh** and **Akshaye Khanna** as **Sanjaya Baru**.
 
 
 
• **Other Prime Ministers mentioned in options:**
 
 
• **Indira Gandhi:** The first female **Prime Minister of India**, known for her leadership during the **1971 War** and the imposition of the **Emergency** in **1975**.
 
• **Atal Bihari Vajpayee:** A prominent leader of the **BJP** who served three terms as **Prime Minister** and was awarded the **Bharat Ratna** in **2015**.
 
• **Rajiv Gandhi:** The youngest **Prime Minister of India**, who took office in **1984** and is credited with the **telecom revolution** and the **computerization** of India.
 
 
 
• **Sanjaya Baru:**
 
 
• Besides being a **media advisor**, he is a veteran **political commentator** and has served as the **editor** of major publications like **The Financial Express** and **Business Standard**.
 
 

6a:T
